loginAuth.noPasswordsBody: Authentication is delegated to Google, Microsoft, or a one-time email link.
loginAuth.enterEmail: Enter the email address that should receive the sign-in link.
loginAuth.magicLinkNotConfigured: Email sign-in links are not configured yet.
loginAuth.magicLinkFailed: The sign-in link could not be sent.
loginAuth.magicLinkInbox: Check your inbox for the secure sign-in link.

identity.title: Identity stays with the provider

providers.title: Google, Microsoft, or a secure email link

tools.title: Real estate marketing tools

helpChecklist.provider: Use the same Google or Microsoft account that owns the mailbox you plan to use.
helpChecklist.magicLink: Magic links are for sign-in only. No password is required.
helpChecklist.microsoft: For Microsoft work accounts, tenant consent may be required before the first use.

accessDenied.title: {{provider}} authorization was not completed
accessDenied.description: The identity provider did not finish the sign-in request. This usually means consent was cancelled, the app is still in testing, or the organization blocked the request.

checklist.retry: Retry the same sign-in method once in a fresh browser tab.
checklist.google: If this is a Google testing app, confirm that the email is listed as a test user.
checklist.microsoft: If this is a Microsoft work account, ask the tenant admin to allow the app or grant consent.

missingEmail.title: {{provider}} did not return a usable email
missingEmail.description: {{appName}} provisions accounts by verified email address. OAuth completed, but the callback did not include a stable mailbox we can attach to a workspace.

checklist.mailbox: Use an account with a real mailbox instead of an alias-only identity.
checklist.microsoft: For Microsoft, prefer the primary work mailbox instead of an external guest identity.
checklist.provider: If the problem repeats, compare the result with another provider.

accountSyncFailed.title: We could not finish account provisioning
accountSyncFailed.description: Authentication succeeded, but {{appName}} could not create or update the local workspace record. This is usually a database or callback configuration problem.

checklist.retry: Retry once to rule out a transient callback failure.
checklist.logs: If it repeats, review the deployment logs for the sign-in callback.
checklist.providers: Do not keep switching providers until the callback issue is fixed.

oauthCallback.title: {{provider}} could not complete the callback
oauthCallback.description: The identity provider redirected back, but the OAuth callback failed before a session could be created.

checklist.redirect: Verify that the redirect URI in Google Cloud or Microsoft Entra matches exactly.
checklist.credentials: Confirm the provider client ID and secret are configured correctly in production.
checklist.logs: Check the callback-route deployment logs around the failure time.

configuration.title: Authentication is not configured correctly
configuration.description: {{appName}} received a request for a provider that is missing credentials, redirect URIs, or environment variables.

checklist.railway: Confirm the provider is configured in the active Railway environment.
checklist.redirect: Make sure the production redirect URI matches the current domain exactly.
checklist.disable: Disable any provider button that is not fully configured.

verification.title: This sign-in link is no longer valid
verification.description: A one-time verification link or callback token has expired, or it has already been used.

checklist.restart: Start the sign-in flow again from the {{appName}} login page.
checklist.history: Avoid reopening an old sign-in link from browser history.

defaultError.title: Sign-in did not complete
defaultError.description: {{appName}} received an unexpected authentication error before the session could be created.

checklist.retry: Retry the same sign-in method once.
checklist.cookies: If it only happens in one browser, clear the site cookies and try again.
checklist.logs: If it repeats, inspect the auth callback logs with the exact failure time.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.summary: This page explains how {{appName}} handles sign-in data, product usage data, and support communications.

collect.heading: What we collect
collect.paragraph1: When you sign in with Google, Microsoft, or an email link, we process the minimum identity data needed to run the account, such as provider identifiers, email address, name, and avatar.
collect.paragraph2: When you use the marketing workflows, we also process the share pages, subscriptions, content requests, and related activity logs needed to provide the product, troubleshoot issues, and prevent abuse.

usage.heading: How we use data
usage.paragraph1: We use this data to authenticate users, preserve workspace state, generate marketing content, send notifications you explicitly request, and keep the platform secure and reliable.
usage.paragraph2: {{appName}} does not sell your content or client leads to third parties unless a disclosure is strictly required to deliver the service.

vendors.heading: Third-party services
vendors.paragraph1: The platform relies on third-party services for OAuth sign-in, email delivery, map services, and hosting. Those vendors process the minimum data required to provide their part of the service.
vendors.paragraph2: You should also review the privacy terms of the relevant providers, especially when using Google, Microsoft, or map-related features.

retention.heading: Retention and contact
retention.paragraph1: We retain data only for as long as required for business operations and compliance. To request access, export, or deletion of account-related data, contact {{supportEmail}}.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.summary: This page describes the core rules, responsibilities, and service limits that apply when you use {{appName}}.

accounts.heading: Accounts and access
accounts.paragraph1: You must access the service through a valid, authorized identity provider account and remain responsible for the activity performed under that account.
accounts.paragraph2: We may suspend or restrict access if we detect abusive behavior, suspicious sign-ins, or material policy violations.

acceptableUse.heading: Acceptable use
acceptableUse.paragraph1: You may not use {{appName}} to send spam, impersonate others, scrape unauthorized data, or publish content that violates applicable law or real-estate industry rules.
acceptableUse.paragraph2: You must ensure that any listing data, media assets, or client information entered into the system is lawfully obtained and permitted for your intended use.

aiContent.heading: AI-generated content
aiContent.paragraph1: Copy, summaries, recommendations, and marketing assets generated by the platform may be AI-assisted. You remain responsible for reviewing all outputs before sharing them externally.
aiContent.paragraph2: {{appName}} does not provide legal, tax, appraisal, brokerage-practice, or fair-housing compliance advice.

liability.heading: Availability and limitation of liability
liability.paragraph1: We keep improving the product, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted service or constant availability of every third-party integration.
liability.paragraph2: To the maximum extent permitted by law, {{appName}} is not liable for indirect losses arising from service interruptions, third-party outages, or inaccurate AI output.

contact.heading: Contact
contact.paragraph1: If you have questions about these terms or need enterprise contracting and compliance support, contact {{supportEmail}}.
